subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw add a read-only, agent-scoped workspace file browser for iOS and Android now, and what authorization scope should file content reads require?
rationale: The product gap is clear, but arbitrary in-workspace reads through Gateway and mobile share sheets can expose sensitive files, and the live issue is protected by `maintainer` plus product/security-review labels.

options.title: Approve Narrow Read-Only Slice
options.body: Proceed with bounded `agents.workspace.list/read` plus mobile browse, preview, and share only after the approved file-read authorization boundary and security tests are in place.

options.title: Defer To Full Workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue open behind the broader https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61368 design and land mobile clients only after that API direction is settled.

options.title: Keep Existing Narrow APIs
options.body: Decline the new mobile workspace browser for now and preserve the current bootstrap-file and session-touched-file boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Read-Only Slice
recommendation.body: Proceed with bounded `agents.workspace.list/read` plus mobile browse, preview, and share only after the approved file-read authorization boundary and security tests are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened this protected feature issue and the stacked maintainer implementation PRs that are already routing the security-boundary decision.
